text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Don't go soft on me, Trainer! We got a race to win, and I want ya to train me to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Tamamo Cross commits to a showdown with Oguri Cap, I put her through the intensive training she asked for. However…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Hey! This whole summer break, I've been workin' like crazy with hardly any rest. Whatcha puttin' me through here?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, I'm surprised I'm still standin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: 'Course I am. Who d'ya think yer dealin' with?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I guess it wasn't all too bad, after all. It's gettin' time to hit the road, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross jogs over to the bus, her every step brimming with contentment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But moments before the bus sets off…

text_block_list.name: Fans Surrounding the Bus
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Crosssss! Do your beeeest!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap, don't go losing now! O-GU-RI! O-GU-RI!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoooa, da heck is this?! They got our bus surrounded!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It looks like these are the locals. They've all come to send us off…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is nice. Their cheering always makes me feel—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah yeah, but they sure are noisy. I mean, it's just some school camp, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as I'm thinking this level of support does feel a little excessive…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this atmosphere is taking me back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. is a winner of the prestigious triple crown. A free-spirited Umamusume, she walks a path that's all her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I'm reeling from the shock of seeing a legendary Umamusume appearing out of the blue…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh my, campsites are never this exciting.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: With a single exception, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh yes, I remember it even now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, keep up the hard work. I expect this autumn will pose quite the challenge for you, too, Trainer. But you should enjoy it to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. saunters off coolly. I relax and take a deep breath before letting it back out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. They're as passionate about racing as their fans are about them. Looks like a remarkable fall is about to begin.
